scope: Requirement-level audit of the TrueCost master goal and its named production and Demo Day deliverables.

checks.requirement: Produce an evidence-backed production-release candidate with typecheck, tests and production build.
checks.boundary: Local checkout only; production configuration, deployment approval and release sign-off remain open.

checks.requirement: Verify Clerk email OTP and fresh Convex comparison, history, report, offline and account flows.
checks.boundary: Development resources and disposable data only; production email delivery, provider retention/deletion and installed-app/device acceptance remain open.

checks.requirement: Implement consented Mixpanel events, identity transitions, payload restrictions and fail-closed behavior.
checks.boundary: The enabled browser run intercepted requests before they left localhost; live ingestion, dashboard reconciliation and provider retention/deletion are unverified.

checks.requirement: Measure consent readiness against input and calculation timing before changing behavior.
checks.boundary: The caller-decision marks show input and completion skipped while the store was loading in the zero-settle run, while the two-second run queued both account pairs after accepted context. The diagnostics isolate readiness variance without buffering unconsented events, delaying calculations or using a navigation workaround; product acceptance remains open.

checks.requirement: Deliver exactly one readable Chronicle-supported one-page PDF and verify the actual export.
checks.boundary: The local PDF is one page and visually inspected; authenticated Chronicle editor access and export retrieval remain unverified.

checks.requirement: Verify Runway access, rights, credits and approved exports before generating supporting clips.
checks.boundary: Guest tool navigation was observed read-only. No generation, export or credit use occurred; account access, rights and approved exports remain open.

checks.requirement: Deliver and verify a 180–240 second real-product pitch/demo with readable captions and audio.
checks.boundary: Both local masters are 180.68 seconds and decode cleanly with no long black segments; full playback/listening, normal-playback caption review and reviewer acceptance remain open.

checks.requirement: Validate the demonstrated public URL, production configuration, rollback/recovery, approvals and submission readiness.
checks.boundary: Production provider configuration, recovery and deletion replay, owner sign-off, public candidate parity, reviewer access and submission approval are not verified.
